data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: resume
sections.summary: a document that lists your education and work experience

senses.definition: a document that gives details about your education and work experience when you apply for a job
examples: She sent her resume to the company.

answers.answer: She updated her resume before applying for the job.

She wrote her salary on her resume yesterdayed.

sections.question: salary
sections.summary: the money you receive for your job

senses.definition: the money you receive regularly for doing your job

answers.answer: She asked about the salary during the interview.
